title: Internal Business Development Executive
description:
As an Internal Business Development Executive in Bristol, you will help build new sales opportunities within the pharmaceutical sector and keep the sales pipeline moving. You will work closely with the territory managers to identify prospects, develop relationships and turn conversations into commercial activity. As well as supporting the sales team with administrative activities.

Michael Page are partnered with Venture Life who's portfolio includes well-known consumer health brands such as Health & Her, Health & Him, Balance Activ, Lift, and Earol. They have a strong reputation across the pharmaceutical and consumer healthcare sector.

Description
- Identify and research potential customers to create a steady flow of new business opportunities.
- Contact prospective customers by phone, email and other suitable channels to introduce relevant solutions.
- Build and maintain relationships with new contacts, understanding their needs and keeping communication clear.
- Qualify enquiries and opportunities, ensuring the sales team focuses on suitable prospects.
- Maintain accurate records of customer conversations, activity and opportunity progress.
- Arrange meetings and follow-ups with prospective customers to move opportunities forward.
- Work with the wider Sales department to share customer information and support a joined-up approach.
- Track business development activity and provide clear updates on pipeline progress.

A successful 'Internal Business Development Executive' should have:
- Experience of identifying and developing new business opportunities.
- Confidence in speaking with prospective customers by phone and email.
- Ability to qualify customer needs and progress sales conversations.
- Experience of maintaining accurate sales or customer records.
- Ability to organise follow-ups and manage several active opportunities.
- Experience of working with colleagues to support sales activity.

Job Offer
- Permanent Internal Business Development Executive position based in Bristol.
- Salary of 30,000 to 35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- 10% bonus.

title: IT Sales Executive
description:
Adecco is recruiting four experienced IT Sales Executives for a growing UK Managed Service Provider. If you are a proven MSP hunter who wants to spend your time closing rather than cold calling, this is a strong opportunity.

Who we are looking for

Our client wants experienced new-business closers from the managed services world. You will be a good fit if you have:
- A proven track record of selling IT managed services, cyber security, cloud and infrastructure solutions,
- Experience persuading businesses to move away from their existing MSP
- A true hunter mindset: confident, self-motivated, competitive and driven by results
- A consultative sales style, with the credibility to advise senior and C-level decision-makers
- The ability to present complex solutions clearly and turn meetings into closed deals
- Good knowledge of the IT industry, current technology and the wider market
- A team-first attitude, celebrating wins and supporting colleagues

Nice to have
- Microsoft certifications
- Experience selling Acronis, Microsoft, Sophos, KnowBe 4, Mimecast or Azure
- A track record selling private and public cloud services
- Strong knowledge of cyber security solutions

The role

This is a new-business hunter role, reporting to the Sales Director. You will be given an agreed number of qualified, booked meetings and will sell fully outsourced IT services to SMEs, using standard IT bundles or bespoke packages.

Your main responsibilities will be to:
- Convert booked meetings into new managed services clients through a consultative approach
- Prepare and tailor presentations and proposals to each prospect's needs
- Generate additional pipeline through networking, phone, LinkedIn and email
- Work with technical colleagues to scope, price and propose solutions
- Build strong client relationships and hand over smoothly to onboarding and account management
- Identify cross-selling opportunities within the existing client base
- Follow the sales process, keep the CRM up to date and meet or exceed KPIs and targets

What is on offer
- 45,000- 55,000 base salary, depending on experience
- 120,000 OTE with uncapped commission
- Qualified, booked meetings, so your time is spent selling

- Private health care and other company benefits

Our client is an established UK Managed Service Provider supplying IT, cyber security and cloud services to small and mid-sized businesses. Full client details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.
